correctness.rationale: Two initially empty arms can never receive a first blue vertex: only the center could act, and it would see both interiors white. If the center starts blue, all nonempty arms can be completed, after which the center starts the possible empty arm. If it starts white, an initially blue leaf is necessary to initiate a move and sufficient to make the center blue. Counting the two cases with A=2z+z² gives (1+z)(A^m+mA^(m−1))−(z^m+mz^(m−1)). Independently expanding with falling factorials confirms the coefficient formula and endpoint degrees. At every interior index the binomial log-concavity defect E expands in j−1,L−1 with positive coefficients and constant 48. The factor m+j preserves strictness. Decreasing q1 helps at j=2, and at j=1 the correction adds 1 plus a nonnegative factor proportional to m−2. This covers m=2 and the entire contiguous support.
